observations.visible: Black moulded-looking elongated shell with broad arched region and distinct tapering/stepped extension. Longitudinal/transverse curvature differs by region; side drop forms a large wheel-clearance arch. Not a uniform half-cylinder or solid box.
observations.limits: Actual resin, wall thickness, inner continuity and full3D curvature unknown. Projected silhouettes from two uncalibrated specimens cannot be fused as a measured envelope.

observations.visible: Broad elevated/plated-looking upper land, rounded transition and two small close upper circular openings visible inP01. P02 shows the land in oblique edge view.
observations.limits: No bore diameters/spacing or hidden underside seat inferred. One dark ring/mark is not automatically an additional hole or insert. Upper surface is not a separate metal plate solely from a reflection.

observations.visible: Extension has several broad planar/faceted regions, a pronounced transverse step/raised wall, longitudinal edges and local tip relief/opening. Both images constrain the visible outer family.
observations.limits: Exact relief heights/depths, orientation to the installed motorcycle and attachment function of each opening remain unresolved. Region names describe photograph, not certified datum or installed direction.

observations.visible: Long raised longitudinal/diagonal ribs and shaped descending side fields, terminal returns visible. P02 clearly exposes one large inner arch silhouette and a small lateral hole region near rounded end.
observations.limits: No opposite-face symmetry, inside rib grid, flange cross-section or mould parting law inferred. Dark bands can be shading; avoid treating all highlights as sharp edges.

observations.visible: Mounted rear includes separate seat/rack/taillamp/signals/plate/reflector and flap elements. Related catalogues distinguish shellJV181408 from flapJV181410.
observations.limits: No receipt/fabrication of flap, plate, light or reflector implied by photographing shell. Lamp/rack/plate18C interfaces require separate handoff; no merged black tail block.
